resources.string: Off: a recipient whose email cannot be encrypted gets nothing.
Warning: recipients whose encryption fails get a readable email.
Only used with S/MIME, OpenPGP or OpenKeychain; your choice is kept.

Applies to S/MIME, OpenPGP and OpenKeychain. Encryption fails when a recipient has no key, the key cannot be read or used, or encrypting goes wrong. Off (recommended): that recipient gets no email and the log says why; the other recipients still get theirs. On: that recipient gets a normal, readable email instead, and the log marks it as unencrypted. A mail server error never leads to an unencrypted copy.
the recipient key could not be read
the recipient key cannot be used for encryption
your signing key or its password could not be used
your signing key needs its password
the email could not be prepared (%1$s)
